'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip]]
***[[2025 Gaza City offensive]]
****At least 53 [[Palestinians]] are killed in [[Israel Defense Forces|Israeli]] attacks across the [[Gaza Strip]] and in [[Gaza City]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/amp/news/2025/10/2/israel-threatens-all-staying-in-gaza-city-kills-at-least-13-in-enclave (Al Jazeera)]
**[[Israeli blockade of the Gaza Strip (2023–present)|Israeli blockade of the Gaza Strip]]
***[[Israel]] intercepts the [[Global Sumud Flotilla]] in [[international waters]] and detains hundreds of [[activists]] from 44 countries carrying [[humanitarian aid]] bound for Gaza, sparking international condemnation and accusations of violations of the [[United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c0lk292jww4o (BBC News)] [https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/mena/2025/10/02/nations-condemn-israels-interception-of-gaza-aid-flotilla/ (''The National'')]
*[[Terrorism in the United Kingdom]]
**[[Manchester synagogue attack]]
***Two people are killed and four others are injured in a [[Vehicle-ramming attack|vehicle-ramming]] and [[mass stabbing]] attack at the [[Heaton Park Hebrew Congregation]] [[synagogue]] in [[Crumpsall]], [[Manchester]], [[England]], [[United Kingdom]]. The perpetrator and one of the victims are shot dead by [[Greater Manchester Police|police]]. The attack is later declared a [[terrorism|terror attack]]. [https://www.cnn.com/world/live-news/manchester-uk-synagogue-attack-10-02-25 (CNN)] [https://www.nytimes.com/2025/10/02/world/europe/uk-manchester-synagogue-attack.html (''The New York Times'')] [https://www.reuters.com/world/uk/uk-police-name-victims-manchester-synagogue-attack-2025-10-03/ (Reuters)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Australia–Papua New Guinea relations]]
**The [[Papua New Guinea|Papua New Guinean]] [[National Executive Council|Cabinet]] approves a bilateral [[defense treaty]] with [[Australia]], which will increase integration of military equipment and personnel between the two countries. [https://apnews.com/article/australia-papua-new-guinea-defense-security-treaty-4e66ff5ae097ec0391775b121cffbb31 (AP)]
*[[Foreign relations of Nicaragua]], [[Foreign relations of Ukraine]], [[International recognition of the Donetsk People's Republic and the Luhansk People's Republic]]
**[[Ukraine]] breaks off diplomatic relations with [[Nicaragua]] over the latter's recognition of [[Russia]]n-[[Russian-occupied territories of Ukraine|occupied territories]] in the country. [https://prm.ua/en/ukraine-breaks-off-diplomatic-relations-with-nicaragua/ (''Priamyi'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2025 Azad Kashmir protests]]
**At least eight people are killed in violent protests in [[Muzaffarabad]], [[Azad Kashmir]], [[Pakistan]], against benefits for the [[political class]] in the region. The [[Government of Azad Kashmir|regional government]] warns local media [[Censorship in Pakistan|against covering]] the protests. [https://www.dw.com/en/pakistan-kashmir-unrest-leaves-8-dead/a-74223546 (DW)]
*At least 195,000 people hold protests across [[France]] to denounce planned budget cuts. [https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20251002-anti-government-protests-france (France 24)]
*The seventh summit of the [[European Political Community]] is held in [[Copenhagen]], [[Denmark]]. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/opinion/opinion-european-leaders-meet-at-copenhagen-what-does-it-reveal-about-europes-security/3706430 (Anadolu Agency)]
